meta.name: QuartzOS Reference Data
meta.description: Production-grade reference data for cannabis concentrate dabbing — banger form factors, concentrates, sensors, and a parameterized metrology calibration model. v2.0.0 replaces the fused single-offset calibration with the research-derived four-term equation: T_IR_Setpoint = T_Ideal + dT_Load + dT_Gradient + dT_emissivity. Sourced from manufacturer documentation (Dab Rite, Highly Educated, Quave, Honeybee Herb), brand guidance (710 Labs, Mood, Press Club), thermophysical properties of fused silica, and 2025-2026 community consensus.
meta.license: Open data for non-commercial integration. Verify temperature recommendations against current community testing before production deployment.
meta.temperature_convention: Two distinct temperature anchors are tracked per concentrate: (1) surface_temp_optimal_f — the INTERIOR QUARTZ SURFACE temperature at the moment of dab introduction (probe-truth, what a Terpometer V1 contact probe reads). (2) fluid_target_optimal_f — the target BOILING TEMPERATURE of the concentrate fluid itself (what determines vapor production and terpene preservation). Surface > fluid by the phase-change load constant (~65°F) which the surface must supply to the cold extract mass on contact.

model_breakdown.dT_Load: calibration.constants.phase_change_load_f — cold-mass + cap heat-sink deficit (sample-mass dependent)
model_breakdown.dT_Gradient_total: banger.gradient_lag_f × wall.gradient_multiplier — transient conduction lag from interior to exterior surface (Fourier's law over wall thickness)
model_breakdown.dT_emissivity: sensor.emissivity_bias_f × banger.emissivity_bias_multiplier — radiometric calculation error from sensor firmware emissivity vs. material true emissivity

data_sources: Dab Rite official documentation and 2025 placement guide (dabrite.com)
420 VapeZone empirical Dab Rite + slurper testing
Press Club temple ball / hash temp guidance
Reddit r/Dabs, r/QuartzBangers, r/COents technique threads (2024-2026)
Thermophysical properties of fused silica (k=1.4 W/m·K, ρ=2200 kg/m³, Cp=730 J/kg·K, ε≈0.92 at 400-600°F)
Stefan-Boltzmann radiometric analysis of Dab Rite Pro v2.2 firmware (ε_set=0.95)
migration_notes_v1_to_v2: REMOVED: banger.ir_offset_f and banger.ir_offset_sign (fused single-offset model)
ADDED: banger.gradient_lag_f — Fourier's-law conduction lag for the banger's measurement geometry
ADDED: banger.emissivity_bias_multiplier — modifies sensor emissivity bias for opaque vs. clear quartz
ADDED: concentrate.fluid_target_optimal_f and fluid_target_range_f — the boiling target before phase-change load
ADDED: sensor.emissivity_bias_f — firmware-vs-material emissivity calculation error (per sensor)
ADDED: wall.gradient_multiplier — wall thickness scales gradient lag (Fourier τ = L²/α)
ADDED: calibration.constants — phase_change_load_f, fused_silica thermal properties
PRESERVED: surface_temp_optimal_f and surface_temp_range_f (probe-truth, contact sensors use directly)
PRESERVED: wall.modifier_f (legacy field — soft additive override on top of gradient_multiplier)

fields.gradient_multiplier: Scalar applied to banger.gradient_lag_f. Standard wall = 1.0. Thin = 0.5 (less lag). Thick = 1.6 (more lag).

explanation: 1. T_Ideal := concentrate.fluid_target_optimal_f (the boiling target of the oil itself)
2. dT_Load := calibration.constants.phase_change_load_f (sensible + latent heat absorbed by the cold extract mass and cap on contact, ~65°F for a 0.1-0.2g dab)
3. dT_Gradient := banger.gradient_lag_f × wall.gradient_multiplier (Fourier's-law conduction lag from interior to the exterior face the IR sensor sees)

4. dT_emissivity := sensor.emissivity_bias_f × banger.emissivity_bias_multiplier (firmware ε_set=0.95 vs. quartz ε_actual≈0.92 produces ~15°F under-reading on Dab Rite for clear quartz; the Opaque Quartz preset cancels most of this for opaque bottoms)
5. For contact probes (Terpometer V1): dT_Gradient and dT_emissivity collapse to 0; setpoint = surface_temp_optimal_f (probe reads interior directly).
6. For e-nail PID: setpoint = surface_temp_optimal_f + sensor.emissivity_bias_f (PID coil-vs-surface offset, NOT radiometric).

constants.phase_change_load_note: Instantaneous interior-surface temperature drop when a 0.1-0.2g cold (70°F) extract mass is introduced and a cold carb cap is seated. Sum of sensible heat (raise oil to boiling point) + latent heat of vaporization + conductive loss to cap. Tolerance ±15°F per dab volume.

fused_silica.note: Constants used to derive gradient_lag_f via Fourier diffusion time τ = L²/α.

workflow_notes.ir_descent_dab: Dab Rite alarms when temp DESCENDS through the set point. Torch past the displayed target, pull the flame, dab when the alarm fires on the way down. Don't dab AT peak torch.
workflow_notes.contact_probe_vs_ir: If you have a Terpometer V1 contact probe AND a Dab Rite, they will show different numbers for the same dab — and both are correct. The probe reads interior surface; the IR reads exterior wall thermal radiation through firmware-assumed emissivity. The new model explicitly accounts for this via the dT_Gradient and dT_emissivity terms.
workflow_notes.opaque_quartz_preset: The Dab Rite Pro v2.2 'Opaque Quartz' emissivity preset largely cancels the ε bias for nucleated/sandblasted bottoms — but does NOT cancel the gradient lag, which is actually LARGER for opaque (air pockets restrict thermal conduction).

flame_anatomy.hottest_point: tip of inner blue cone where it meets outer envelope
flame_anatomy.common_misconception: Cone interior looks brightest but is NOT hottest — heat peaks at the cone tip where combustion completes

universal_rules: Use the TIP of the bright blue inner cone — not the cone interior
Keep flame moving — no stationary points (creates hot spots, devitrification)
Never torch a wet banger (thermal shock cracks quartz)
Never torch the joint connection (stress fractures)
Never torch with carb cap on during hot-start (uneven heat trapping)
Never torch to clean residue between dabs (carbonizes residue into surface)
common_mistakes: Chasing the orange glow every dab (devitrifies quartz, burns terps)
Stationary point heating (hot spots → chazzing → microfractures)
Torching with cap on during hot-start
Holding flame too close (buries quartz in cooler reducing zone)
Skipping cooldown after glow (concentrate combusts instead of vaporizes)
Using inner cone interior instead of cone tip
Torching to burn off residue between dabs

banger_geometries.description: Exterior measurement face cools faster than interior — IR reads lower than dab interface during cooldown.

banger_geometries.label: Slurper-class
banger_geometries.description: Side-of-column aim. Thin wall, small gradient lag.

banger_geometries.label: Insert workflow
banger_geometries.description: Read host banger temp + extra gradient through insert.

banger_geometries.label: E-nail (electric)
banger_geometries.description: PID setpoint; coil-vs-surface offset handled in sensor.emissivity_bias_f.

torch_patterns.label: Circular sweep — focus floor, not pillar

wall_thicknesses.name: Thin (2 mm)
wall_thicknesses.description: Light flat tops. Faster heat, faster cool. Smaller interior↔exterior gradient.

wall_thicknesses.name: Standard (3-4 mm)
wall_thicknesses.description: Typical premium banger. Default. Banger gradient_lag_f values are anchored here.

wall_thicknesses.name: Thick (5-6 mm)
wall_thicknesses.description: Heavy reactor / opaque floor. More retention, larger gradient — Fourier τ scales as L².

sensors.name: Probe (Terpometer V1)
sensors.description: Contact thermocouple touches the interior quartz floor. Reads interior SURFACE TRUTH directly via physical conduction.
sensors.calibration_note: No offsets applied — your reading IS the interior surface temp. Setpoint = concentrate.surface_temp_optimal_f directly.

sensors.name: IR Thermometer (Dab Rite Pro v2.2, Octave, Terpometer Gen 2)
sensors.description: Non-contact infrared thermopile. Aim per banger geometry — bucket-class reads the exterior floor (cooler than interior during cooldown), slurper-class reads side-of-column (closer to interior). Firmware ε_set = 0.95; clear quartz ε_actual ≈ 0.92.
sensors.calibration_note: Apply both dT_Gradient (banger geometry) and dT_emissivity (firmware-vs-material bias). The 0.03 emissivity mismatch causes the sensor to UNDER-report by ~15°F at typical dab temperatures. Workflow: dab on descent through target, NOT at peak torch.

sensors.name: E-Nail PID Setpoint
sensors.description: Coil temperature controller. Set-and-forget. Coil reads 30-80°F higher than interior surface (varies by brand). emissivity_bias_f here is repurposed for the coil-vs-surface offset midpoint.
sensors.calibration_note: Add ~50°F midpoint to surface_temp_optimal_f. MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface temp directly — set PID to surface target, not the +50°F estimate. Other brands: tune via test dabs.

sensors.name: No Thermometer (Visual / Timing)
sensors.description: Glow + count method. Approximate. App estimates from form factor and cooldown_seconds.
sensors.calibration_note: Use IR-equivalent values as approximate guidance. Visual cue (banger.visual_cue) is the primary signal.

bangers.name: Flat Top
bangers.description: Universal default. Cylindrical bucket, flat rim. ~80% of bangers in market.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center underside of bucket bottom, 1/2" away

bangers.name: Beveled Edge
bangers.description: Inward-cut bevel for flush bubble cap seal. Better seal lets you target 20-40°F lower than non-beveled flat top.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center underside of bucket bottom, 1/2" away

bangers.name: Opaque Bottom
bangers.description: Sandblasted/frosted bottom disc with nucleated silica. Air pockets boost surface area for boil but also act as a strong thermal barrier (large gradient lag). Use Dab Rite "Opaque Quartz" preset to cancel most emissivity bias.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Center of opaque bottom underside, 1/2" away (Dab Rite: switch to Opaque Quartz preset)
bangers.visual_cue: Faint side-wall glow only — opaque hides bottom glow

bangers.name: Thermal (Double Wall)
bangers.description: Air gap between walls insulates inner cup. IR reads dramatically cooler than oil contact temp because IR sees the outer wall across an air gap.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Outer base of bucket, 1/2" away (manufacturer-correct aim)
bangers.visual_cue: No glow / faint outer corner glow only

bangers.name: Round Bottom
bangers.description: Hemispherical interior, no corners. Best shape for terp pearls (rolls freely) and cold start (oil pools center).
bangers.ir_aim_location: Lowest curve apex (= bottom center), 1/2" away
bangers.visual_cue: Just before glow on the curve

bangers.name: Core Reactor
bangers.description: Central pillar increases surface area + thermal mass. Larger gradient lag than plain bucket due to extra mass. Cold-start compatible per Honeybee Herb.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Inner bucket floor around pillar, 1/2" away
notable_manufacturers: Honeybee Herb Honey & Milk Core Reactor

bangers.name: Swing-Arm Honey Bucket
bangers.description: Legacy form factor — heat dome out of chamber, swing back in. NOT cold-start compatible.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Outside of dome in heating position, ~1" away

bangers.name: Terp Slurper
bangers.description: Bottom dish + slotted column + bucket. Marble cap. Hot-start required — vortex needs preheat. IR aimed at side of column, NOT dish underside.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of cup ~1/2" above the dish (column, NOT dish underside) — Dab Rite 2025 spec

bangers.name: Blender / Vector
bangers.description: Slotted hurricane disc spins pearls automatically. Tighter temp window than slurper. Side-of-tower aim — thin wall, small gradient lag.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the tower at mid-height (slurper-class aim — NOT disc underside)

bangers.name: Spinner / Tourbillon
bangers.description: Angled airflow holes drive pearl spin via inhale velocity. Pearl spin is airflow-driven, not temperature-driven.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of bucket wall mid-height (avoid drilled holes — radial crack risk)

bangers.name: Control Tower
bangers.description: Highly Educated proprietary slurper with SE Pillar (Surface Enhanced micro-textured quartz). Manufacturer targets: 450°F solventless / 550°F hydrocarbon (interior surface).
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the chamber, NOT the dish (Highly Educated FAQ)
bangers.heat_method: simultaneous (heat dish + chamber together, side-to-side AND top-to-bottom)
bangers.visual_cue: Pillar visibly at temp, faint glow in dim room

bangers.name: Quave Charmer
bangers.description: Quave proprietary slurper-blender hybrid. Outer dish with vortex holes, inner cone, three pearls, marble cap.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Side of the cup wall (slurper-class — inferred, no first-party doc)

bangers.name: Quartz Insert (in any banger)
bangers.description: Drop-in cup. Either heat host first then drop insert, or load insert cold and heat host briefly. IR reads host banger, with extra gradient lag from host-to-insert thermal transfer.
bangers.ir_aim_location: Host banger bottom, 1/2" away (read banger temp, not insert directly)

bangers.name: E-Banger / E-Nail
bangers.description: Coil-wrapped quartz with PID. Coil reads 30-80°F hotter than surface (varies widely by brand). MiniNail-on-MiniNail is factory-calibrated to display surface directly.
bangers.ir_aim_location: PID set point — no IR / no torch needed
